request.description: Cozy whimsical fantasy inn game, crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art, readable chunky shapes, limited muted moss green and warm brown palette, restrained shading, no text, no interface, no blur. Single human fantasy tavern innkeeper, a squat chunky 2D RPG game sprite viewed from slightly above, south-facing. Full figure from hair to both shoes visible with generous empty margins. Brown hair parted in the middle, cream rolled sleeves, maroon waistcoat, cocoa apron, dark boots, a strained welcoming smile. Warm muted colors, broad clean pixel clusters, simple shading. One person standing with hands at sides, isolated on transparent background. No furniture, objects, or room.
